scope: cleanup failure propagation and workflow retry/resume

findings.finding: Post-commit cleanup failure could precede persistence of applied state
findings.resolution: Persist applied before cleanup and report applied with pending cleanup

findings.finding: Workflow retry swallowed cleanup uncertainty and discarded the path
findings.resolution: Persist failure classification and isolation, block retry/resume and uncertain finalization

findings.finding: Applied-state persistence failure and concurrent stale requests could replay mutation
findings.resolution: Persist and verify applying intent; serialize by repository identity and reload under lock; retain unconfirmed state

findings.finding: Direct runGit reuse introduced a forward cycle edge
findings.resolution: Use AgentWorktreeHooks binding; dependency debt ceiling unchanged

scopeLimit: Repository application mutex is process-local; no claim of serialization against independent services or external Git
